items.title: The quoted ratio study cannot be traced
items.whyItMatters: The board's belief that a fixed ratio prevents most injuries rests on a study that was not retrieved; the model offered it only as an unverified landmark lead with a DOI no search returned.
items.opportunity: Report to the board what the retrieved evidence shows (an association, c1) and run an identity check before anyone cites the lead.

items.title: Incident reports would distort the run chart
items.whyItMatters: Reports capture about two thirds of injuries and rise with attention (c3).
items.opportunity: Use weekly skin inspection as the outcome measure with a counting rule fixed before baseline.

items.title: Early injuries are missed in darker skin
items.whyItMatters: Category 1 injuries were missed far more often in darker skin (c4).
items.opportunity: Include touch-based assessment in the round and report injuries by skin tone category.

items.title: Weekly counts are too sparse for a run chart
items.whyItMatters: With about three or four injuries a month across both wards, weekly charts are mostly zeros.
items.opportunity: Chart patient-days between injuries, with monthly rates as a secondary display.

items.title: Float nurse availability is not guaranteed
items.whyItMatters: Float nurses were available on 61 percent of qualifying nights elsewhere.
items.opportunity: Record float availability every night and test the round without the float nurse in cycle 1.

errorsFound: A discovery lead reused the id of the retrieved before-after report and renamed it as a controlled trial that eliminated injuries; it was quarantined, and the appraisal's attempt to retitle the record was refused.
A lead labelled landmark with DOI 10.5555/nsj.2018.0777 was not retrieved and remains unverified.
reevaluation: The gaps confirm a PDSA project with inspection-based measurement, charts suited to rare events, equity reporting by skin tone, and an honest message to the board about staffing evidence.
summary: Five gaps; the untraceable ratio study and measurement distortion are high severity.
